## 📌 Description

Establish the bare-bones Maven project, GitHub Actions pipelines, validation scripts, and the repository structure required for all future development.


## ✅ Tasks

- [ ] **Maven Initialisation**
  - `pom.xml` with Java 21
  - `groupId`: `com.qa.playwright`
  - `artifactId`: `playwright-hybrid-framework`
  - Version: `0.0.0-SNAPSHOT`
  - Enforce UTF-8 encoding and compiler release 21

- [ ] **GitHub Actions Pipelines**
  - `main-ci.yml` – POM validation, build, test, security (OWASP), quality (Checkstyle)
  - `feature-pr.yml` – fast validation for `feature/*` branches
  - `release-pr.yml` – SemVer release automation (GPG signed tags, PR creation)

- [ ] **Automation Scripts**
  - `pom-validator.sh` v2.4 – strict XML validation, HTML reports, dependency/plugin checks
  - `milestones.sh` – milestone synchronisation & health management
  - `issues.sh` – batch issue creation
  - `feature-pr.sh` – automated feature PR creation with CI gating
  - `release-pr.sh` – automated release PR (`dev -> main`)

- [ ] **Repository Structure**

```text
.github/
├── workflows/
├── issues/
├── features/
└── releases/

scripts/
src/main/java/
src/test/java/
Reports/
```

## 🔍 Validation

- [ ] Run `./scripts/pom-validator.sh --strict --html` — must pass with 0 failures
- [ ] All GitHub Actions must run successfully on `main` and `dev`

## 🎯 Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] CI pipeline green on `dev` after merge of this issue’s PR
- [ ] `pom.xml` is valid and `mvn clean verify` completes without errors
- [ ] HTML report generated in `Reports/pom-validation-report.html`
- [ ] Tag `v0.0.0` can be created manually from `main`

## 📎 Dependencies

- [ ] GitHub repository `hybrid-framework` exists with owner `opencode-qa`
- [ ] GH CLI authenticated
- [ ] `GPG_PRIVATE_KEY`, `GH_PAT`, and `NVD_API_KEY` secrets configured

## 🧪 Testing

- [ ] Verify `pom-validator.sh` fails on malformed XML
- [ ] `feature-pr.yml` triggers on `feature/*` push
- [ ] `release-pr.yml` dry-run works without API calls
